description:
[RoHS 3 restricted substance limit checker & technical exemption auditor. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Verifies homogeneous material compliance under Directive 2011/65/EU and Delegated Directive 2015/863 across 10 restricted heavy metals and phthalates, auditing Annex III/IV technical exemptions.
Usage: Pass measured ppm values for homogeneous materials with optional exemption codes (e.g. '6c' for lead in copper alloys).
Returns: JSON object with { homogeneousMaterialName: string, isRoHsCompliant: boolean, passCount: number, failCount: number, evaluations: array }.

homogeneousMaterialName.description: Homogeneous material identifier (e.g. Copper Alloy C36000, PVC Cable Sheath)

exemptionCodeApplied.description: Applicable RoHS Annex III technical exemption code (e.g. 6a, 6b, 6c, 7a, 7c-I)

measuredPpm.description: Measured concentration in parts per million (ppm)

name: rohs_substance_limit_checker
